title: Healthy neural priors improve BCI decoding in patients with motor-cortex gliomas
summary: A Pathology-Aware Consensus Training (PACT) decoder embeds biophysical constraints from healthy recordings into training. On gesture classification from high-density ECoG of glioma patients infiltrating motor cortex, accuracy rose by more than 10%, and the correlation of motor-command geometry with healthy references rose from r=0.66 to r=0.94. The authors frame it as a proof of concept for clinical-population BCIs.
ai_technology: Pathology-Aware Consensus Training (PACT), a neural decoder trained with biophysical constraints
organization: National Clinical Research Center for Geriatric

evidence.tested: Gesture classification from high-density ECoG of patients with gliomas infiltrating motor cortex, comparing PACT with conventional training.
evidence.unknown: Proof of concept only; sample size, cross-patient generalization and clinical deployment are not stated in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: PACT is the decoding model; it uses healthy neural recordings as priors and learns to suppress pathological noise and reweight spatial attention.
